001package net.tnemc.paper;
002
003import net.tnemc.item.AbstractItemStack;
004import net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack;
005import net.tnemc.item.providers.ItemProvider;
006import org.bukkit.Material;
007import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
008import org.json.simple.JSONObject;
009
010import java.util.Base64;
011import java.util.Objects;
012
013/**
014 * An opaque native item used when transporting existing items, including overflow.
015 * Only its amount and inventory slot are mutable. No TNIL serializer or component
016 * applicator participates in capture, copying, comparison, or persistence.
017 */
018public final class PaperItemSnapshot extends PaperItemStack {
019
020  private static final String PROVIDER_ID = "tne_native_snapshot";
021  private static final ItemProvider<ItemStack> PROVIDER = new SnapshotProvider();
022
023  private final ItemStack snapshot;
024
025  public PaperItemSnapshot(final ItemStack item) {
026
027    Objects.requireNonNull(item, "Cannot capture a null item");
028    if(item.getType().isAir() || item.getAmount() <= 0) {
029      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot capture an empty item");
030    }
031    snapshot = item.clone();
032    super.material(snapshot.getType().getKey().toString());
033    super.amount(snapshot.getAmount());
034    super.setItemProvider(PROVIDER_ID);
035  }
036
037  public ItemStack copy(final int amount) {
038
039    requireUnmodified();
040    if(amount <= 0) {
041      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Native item amount must be positive");
042    }
043    final ItemStack copy = snapshot.clone();
044    copy.setAmount(amount);
045    return copy;
046  }
047
048  private void requireUnmodified() {
049
050    if(Material.matchMaterial(material()) != snapshot.getType() || !components().isEmpty()
051       || !flags().isEmpty() || !persistentHolder().getData().isEmpty()
052       || !PROVIDER_ID.equals(itemProvider())) {
053      throw new IllegalStateException("Native item snapshots support amount and slot changes only; edit a native copy and capture it again");
054    }
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public ItemProvider<ItemStack> provider() {
059
060    return PROVIDER;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public ItemStack cacheLocale() {
065
066    return copy(amount());
067  }
068
069  @Override
070  public void updateCache(final ItemStack item) {
071
072    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Capture a new native item snapshot instead of replacing its cache");
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public PaperItemStack of(final ItemStack item) {
077
078    return new PaperItemSnapshot(item);
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  public PaperItemStack of(final String material, final int amount) {
083
084    return new PaperItemSnapshot(new ItemStack(Objects.requireNonNull(Material.matchMaterial(material)), amount));
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public JSONObject toJSON() {
089
090    final JSONObject json = new JSONObject();
091    json.put("nativeItem", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(copy(amount()).serializeAsBytes()));
092    json.put("slot", slot());
093    return json;
094  }
095
096  @Override
097  public PaperItemStack of(final JSONObject json) {
098
099    return fromJSON(json);
100  }
101
102  public static PaperItemSnapshot fromJSON(final JSONObject json) {
103
104    if(!(json.get("nativeItem") instanceof String encoded)) {
105      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing native item snapshot");
106    }
107    final PaperItemSnapshot result = new PaperItemSnapshot(ItemStack.deserializeBytes(Base64.getDecoder().decode(encoded)));
108    if(json.get("slot") instanceof Number slot) {
109      result.slot(slot.intValue());
110    }
111    return result;
112  }
113
114  private static final class SnapshotProvider implements ItemProvider<ItemStack> {
115
116    @Override
117    public String identifier() {
118
119      return PROVIDER_ID;
120    }
121
122    @Override
123    public boolean appliesTo(final AbstractItemStack<? extends ItemStack> original, final ItemStack item) {
124
125      return original instanceof PaperItemSnapshot && similar(original, item);
126    }
127
128    @Override
129    public boolean similar(final AbstractItemStack<? extends ItemStack> original, final ItemStack compare) {
130
131      return compare != null && !compare.getType().isAir() && locale(original, 1).isSimilar(compare);
132    }
133
134    @Override
135    public boolean similar(final AbstractItemStack<? extends ItemStack> original,
136                           final AbstractItemStack<? extends ItemStack> compare) {
137
138      return compare instanceof PaperItemStack stack && similar(original, stack.provider().locale(stack, 1));
139    }
140
141    @Override
142    public ItemStack locale(final AbstractItemStack<? extends ItemStack> original, final int amount) {
143
144      return ((PaperItemSnapshot)original).copy(amount);
145    }
146  }
147}
